verdict.rationale: Maritime runs each agent in its own cloud micro-VM, away from the user's machine (maritime-docs-37). Secrets are encrypted at rest and injected only into that agent's VM (maritime-docs-33), and scoped keys limit what a leaked credential can do (maritime-docs-26, maritime-docs-44). This gives meaningful isolation from host and cross-agent secrets. However, nothing documents a sandbox boundary that keeps credentials away from the code the agent runs: the injected secrets are by design readable inside the VM. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox that withholds secrets/credentials from agent-executed code (e.g. proxy-held or brokered credentials), details of the VM isolation boundary, independent or hands-on corroboration.
